sprintName: Kahoot-Hybrid Quiz Maker Studio & Execution Engine
goals: Build quiz studio with 10–20 minute timer constraint
Support manual quiz creation, JSON/CSV upload, and automated question extraction from lecture documents
Student interactive quiz taking experience with 75% passing mark and immediate MongoDB persistence
Integrate anti-tampering integrity monitoring and direct module-to-quiz prerequisite unlocking

issues.title: [Quiz Maker] Quiz Studio with 10–20 Minute Configurable Countdown Timer
issues.description: Enforce quiz time limits strictly between 10 minutes minimum and 20 minutes maximum in both quiz creation studio and runtime countdown timer.
issues.implementationDetails:
### Implementation Architecture & Details

#### 1. Scope & Objective
Configurable active countdown timer strictly constrained between 10 minutes minimum and 20 minutes maximum (Requirement 6).

#### 2. Technical Specifications
- **Validation**: Quiz creation form rejects values < 10 or > 20 minutes.
- **Runtime Timer**: High-precision interval timer with visual circular progress bar and pulse warnings during final 2 minutes.
- **Auto-Submission**: Automated submission payload dispatch when timer reaches 00:00.

issues.title: [Quiz Maker] Multi-Mode Quiz Creation (Manual, JSON/CSV Upload, and Text/File Extraction)
issues.description: Support interactive question builder, bulk JSON/CSV quiz file uploads, and auto-generation of quiz questions from uploaded lecture materials/text.
issues.implementationDetails:
### Implementation Architecture & Details

#### 1. Scope & Objective
Multi-mode quiz builder enabling manual interactive question entry, bulk file uploads, and lecture-based quiz synthesis.

#### 2. Supported Formats
- **Manual Mode**: Question text, 4 options, radio select correct answer, explanation field.
- **File Mode**: JSON / CSV quiz templates with automatic parsing and preview.
- **Lecture Data Extraction**: Extraction from uploaded notes/presentations.

issues.title: [Quiz Engine] Student Interactive Quiz Taker with 75% Passing Threshold Enforcement & Database Upload
issues.description: Deliver interactive quiz taker inspired by Kahoot-style interface, enforcing the mandatory 75% passing mark to mark module completion, and instantly saving submissions to MongoDB Atlas.
issues.implementationDetails:
### Implementation Architecture & Details

#### 1. Scope & Objective
Student interactive quiz taking interface inspired by Kahoot-hybrid aesthetics with 75% passing mark enforcement and MongoDB upload.

#### 2. Key Components
- **Model**: `QuizSubmission.ts` (`quizId`, `studentId`, `score`, `totalQuestions`, `percentage`, `passed`, `answers`).
- **Scoring**: `percentage = (score / totalQuestions) * 100`. `passed = percentage >= 75`.
- **Instant Persistence**: Immediate database write to MongoDB Atlas.

issues.title: [Quiz Maker] Automated Question Generator & NLP Extractor from Uploaded Lecture Notes, Slides, and Text
issues.description: Implement heuristic parser and question generator that analyzes uploaded lecture documents (PDF/presentation/text) to automatically extract core definitions and concepts into multiple-choice quiz questions with distractors and explanations.
issues.implementationDetails:
### Implementation Architecture & Details

#### 1. Scope & Objective
Automated question generation engine analyzing uploaded lecture slides, PDF documents, and lecture text to generate quiz questions.

#### 2. Algorithm & Mechanics
- Extracts key terminology, definitions, and conceptual sentences.
- Synthesizes question stems, identifies correct answers, and generates plausible distractor options.
- Previews questions in the Quiz Studio for faculty review and customization before publishing.

issues.title: [Quiz Maker] Question Bank Import Validator (JSON/CSV/Aiken formats) with Format Linting & Schema Enforcement
issues.description: Provide a robust file import pipeline for question banks supporting JSON and CSV formats with schema validation, answer key verification, question randomization, and inline error highlighting.
issues.implementationDetails:
### Implementation Architecture & Details

#### 1. Scope & Objective
Format linter and schema validator for bulk uploaded question banks in JSON and CSV formats.

#### 2. Validation Checks
- Minimum question count verification (ensuring enough items for statistically sound 75% threshold).
- Valid correct option index bounds check.
- Inline highlighting for missing fields or malformed syntax.

issues.title: [Quiz Engine] Anti-Tampering & Academic Integrity Monitor (Tab Blur Detection & Single-Session Timer)
issues.description: Implement academic integrity safeguards during active quiz sessions: browser tab-switch/window blur detection warning counter, single-session token locks to prevent concurrent attempts, and automatic submission upon timer expiry.
issues.implementationDetails:
### Implementation Architecture & Details

#### 1. Scope & Objective
Anti-tampering and academic integrity safeguards conforming to the institutional Academic Honor Code.

#### 2. Technical Safeguards
- **Tab-Switching / Blur Monitor**: Tracks `window.onblur` and warns candidate on focus loss.
- **Single Active Session**: Prevents duplicate concurrent quiz sessions under same student account.
- **Timestamp Integrity**: Server-side expiration checks preventing client clock manipulation.

issues.title: [Curriculum] Module-to-Quiz Direct Binding, Immediate Retakes & Dynamic Prerequisite Unlock Trigger
issues.description: Bind modules to their end quizzes, unlock progression at 75%, and allow immediate module quiz retakes after passing or failing.
issues.implementationDetails:
### Implementation Architecture & Details

#### 1. Scope & Objective
Direct linkage between topic modules and end quizzes with automated milestone progression triggers.

#### 2. Trigger Mechanics
- Upon quiz submission scoring >= 75%, an automated progression trigger marks the module completed in `StudentProgress`.
- Subsequent module in course sequence immediately transitions from locked to unlocked.
- Failed attempts (< 75%) retain locked status and recommend retrieval study review.

User-requested update: Module quiz retakes have no waiting interval. Each new attempt independently shuffles answer choices; resuming an attempt preserves its original choice order and saved answers.

scopeUpdate.details: Original issue titles and acceptance text are retained as historical GitHub records. Fixed 10–20 minute total timing and 75% passing rules are superseded: new quizzes use faculty-set time per question in seconds/minutes, passing percentages from 1–100%, and 1–100 questions per attempt up to bank size. Runtime, progression, and reports use these settings; historical quizzes/results retain their prior timing and grading.

Existing GitHub issue titles and statuses remain historical records. See sprint-audit.json accountAndOwnershipUpdate for current rules and validation.

scriptGenerationFollowUp.scope: Improve local rule-based lecture extraction and quiz drafts without AI services or usage charges.
implementationDetails: Recognizes colon/equal/spaced-dash definitions, is/are/refers-to descriptions, two-column tables, heading-description pairs, wrapped lines and factual sentences using a documented set of predicates.

Generates description matching, term identification and source-preserving cloze questions. Faculty choose mixed/description/term style and a 1?20 question limit. Long lectures are sampled across their length; target evaluation is bounded at 100 candidate facts.

Deduplicates descriptions and acronym aliases, flags repeated terms with differing descriptions, and excludes answer-revealing or near-identical descriptions. Distractors are ranked by lexical overlap, source label and comparable length.
Adds source-line/slide evidence to explanations and preview diagnostics for usable facts, duplicates, skipped lines, question mix and review warnings.

PowerPoint extraction follows presentation relationships instead of physical filenames, parses XML namespaces/entities/run text and line breaks, preserves two-column table associations, and omits hidden slides and speaker notes.

Bounds PowerPoint expansion (500 slides, 5000 archive entries, 4 MB per XML part, 20 MB expanded XML, 250000 extracted characters), rejects DTDs/malformed XML/broken slide relationships, and retains TXT/MD/PDF/DOCX support.

limits: Generation remains English-oriented rule-based recall, not semantic reasoning or factual verification. Faculty must review the supplied facts and all answer choices.
No OCR, image/diagram understanding, speaker-note parsing, or automatic module creation is included.
More complex tables and prose outside supported patterns can be skipped; similarity filtering may return fewer than the requested number of questions.

implementationDetails: Quiz Studio defaults to the supported existing module attachment in Generate from lecture, with a separate notes/other-file option. No second upload is performed; the request contains JSON settings and the opened module version.

POST /api/quizzes/generate/module/:moduleId reuses the shared local document extractor and question generator. It checks subject/module ownership, supports legacy creator fallback, confines file reads to UPLOAD_DIR, caps reads at 25 MB, and rejects missing/unsupported sources.

Module versions and stored file references are checked before and after parsing to reject stale or concurrently changed sources. Generation returns a draft and source filename/version metadata without creating or binding a quiz.
The existing faculty review and explicit publication step persists the generated questions and evidence. Source switching does not replace the module attachment.
